title: Call code matches the schema: inbound endpoint, routing, missed calls, extraction follow-ups, dial page lead link
goal: Remove the hidden errors in the call code so an inbound call can be logged and routed, and calls started from a lead stay linked to it.
why: Schema drift verified 2026-10-14: services/call-routing.ts queries contacts.mobile and contacts.work_phone (in no migration) and leads.phone; routes/voip-callbacks.ts inserts call_logs with created_by = 'system' while the column is NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id); queues/ai-extraction-queue.ts inserts follow_ups with due_date and assigned_to (the table has scheduled_at). Desktop dial page reads only phone and never sends leadId; lib/api/voip.ts sends `number` where /voip/caller-info expects `phone`. CALL-AUTOMATION.md 4.4 items 2, 3 and 8.
steps: Tenant 0044: rebuild call_logs so created_by is nullable (SQLite: CREATE TABLE call_logs_new with identical columns/constraints except created_by NULL, INSERT SELECT, DROP, RENAME, recreate every index on call_logs; read the current definition from 0017/0018/0019/0024 and schema-drift migrations first). Add UNIQUE index on provider_call_id where not null (CALL-AUTOMATION 3.2). Mirror in tenant-schema.ts. Re-run npm run db:bundle-tenant (R103).
voip-callbacks.ts /twiml/inbound: insert created_by NULL; attach the open lead when a contact matches (newest lead for that contact whose status is not won/lost); call_logs.lead_id set.

call-routing.ts: contact match on contacts.phone and contacts.alternate phone columns that exist (read tenant-schema.ts contacts; use only real columns, compare on normalised last 10 digits as today); lead match via leads.contact_id join instead of leads.phone; run the lead lookup also when a contact matched; default strategy 'assigned' falls back to round_robin among active agents when no owner exists, instead of voicemail.
ai-extraction-queue.ts follow-ups insert: use scheduled_at, assigned to the lead owner through the columns follow_ups actually has (read the schema), status pending.

routes/calls.ts outcome handling: keep behaviour but emit lead.status_changed through the event helper when it changes a lead's status (so automations see it), and allow saving the outcome on inbound rows with created_by NULL by the routed agent (routed_to = user) or admin.
Desktop: dial page reads contactId and leadId from the URL and sends them to POST /calls/outbound; lib/api/voip.ts caller-info sends phone.

schema-drift.test.ts: add a guard that runs PRAGMA table_info for contacts, leads, follow_ups, notifications, call_logs and asserts every column referenced by the call code exists (list them in the test).
tests: backend/test/voip-inbound.test.ts (signed requests once R107 has merged; R107 runs later in the order, so for now unsigned works; if R107 already merged use its signTwilio helper): inbound from an unknown number creates a call_logs row with created_by NULL and returns TwiML that dials an agent or voicemail; inbound from a known contact with an open lead sets contact_id and lead_id; extraction job creates a follow_up with scheduled_at.
acceptance: The column guard test passes and fails if a removed column is referenced again.
Inbound endpoint no longer throws on insert (test).
gate: cd backend && npx vitest run   # pass: 0 failed files and passed >= the last merged count (1296 on 2026-10-14)
cd desktop && npx tsc --noEmit && npx tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json --noEmit
cd desktop && npx vitest run   # pass: 0 failing files, passed >= last merged count (1294 on 2026-10-14)
cd desktop && E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3110 E2E_API_URL=http://localhost:8797/api/v1 npx playwright test e2e/calls.spec.ts
notes: Before editing read: this batch file, docs/readiness/READINESS-PLAN.md sections 0 and the design note for this area, desktop/audit/fix/FIX-PLAN.md sections 3-4 (executor rules, worktree bootstrap with node_modules junctions; never npm install inside a worktree unless the batch adds a dependency, and then only in the main checkout by the orchestrator).

Backend tests follow the existing pattern (see backend/test/voip-callbacks.test.ts): import env, createExecutionContext, waitOnExecutionContext, applyD1Migrations from cloudflare:test; applyD1Migrations(env.MASTER_DB, env.TEST_MIGRATIONS) in beforeAll; POST /api/v1/test/reset; call worker.fetch(request, env, ctx). isolatedStorage is false and singleWorker true, so use unique ids/emails per test file.

Desktop UI follows desktop/audit/remake/CONTRACT.md: ds-* indigo tokens only (no raw palette classes or hex), archetypes (ListPage/EntityForm/DetailPage or PageContainer + PageHeader), FilterBar + useInfiniteScroll for lists, RelationCombobox for relations, PhoneInput for phones, useConfirm instead of window.confirm, graceful degradation when an env key is missing. lint-gate must not rise for any file you touch.

Rebuilding a table with foreign keys in D1: PRAGMA foreign_keys cannot be toggled inside the migration batch in D1; use PRAGMA defer_foreign_keys = true at the top of the migration as Cloudflare documents, and make sure no other table references call_logs in a way that breaks (call_transcripts, ai_call_extractions reference it: recreate in the right order or keep ids identical so references stay valid).
